ayahs.1: Aasmanon aur zameen ki har cheez Allah Taala ki paaki bayan karti hai, aur woh Ghalib Ba-Hikmat hai.
ayahs.2: Wohi hai jis ne Ahl-e-Kitab mein se kaafiron ko un ke gharon se pehle hashr ke waqt nikala, tumhara gumaan (bhi) na tha ke woh niklenge aur woh khud (bhi) samajh rahe the ke un ke (sangeen) qile unhein Allah (ke azaab) se bacha lenge. Pas un par Allah (ka azaab) aisi jagah se aa pada ke unhein gumaan bhi na tha aur un ke dilon mein Allah ne raub daal diya. Woh apne gharon ko apne hi haathon ujaad rahe the aur musalmanon ke haathon (barbaad karwa rahe the). Pas ae aankhon walo! Ibrat hasil karo.
ayahs.3: Aur agar Allah Taala ne un par jila-watni ko muqaddar na kar diya hota to yaqeenan unhein dunya hi mein azaab deta, aur aakhirat mein (to) un ke liye aag ka azaab hai hi.
ayahs.4: Yeh is liye ke unhon ne Allah Taala ki aur us ke Rasool ki mukhalifat ki aur jo bhi Allah ki mukhalifat karega to Allah Taala bhi sakht azaab karne wala hai.
ayahs.5: Tum ne khajooron ke jo darakht kaat daale ya jinhein tum ne un ki jadon par baaqi rehne diya. Yeh sab Allah Taala ke farmaan se tha aur is liye bhi ke faasiqon ko Allah Taala ruswa kare.
ayahs.6: Aur un ka jo maal Allah Taala ne apne Rasool ke haath lagaya hai jis par na to tum ne apne ghode daudaye hain aur na oont balke Allah Taala apne Rasool ko jis par chaahe ghalib kar deta hai, aur Allah Taala har cheez par qaadir hai.
ayahs.7: Bastiyon walon ka jo (maal) Allah Taala tumhare lade bhide baghair apne Rasool ke haath lagaye woh Allah ka hai aur Rasool ka aur qarabat walon ka aur yateemon, miskeenon ka aur musaafiron ka hai taake tumhare daulatmandon ke haath mein hi yeh maal gardish karta na reh jaaye aur tumhein jo kuchh Rasool de le lo, aur jis se roke ruk jaao aur Allah Taala se darte raha karo, yaqeenan Allah Taala sakht azaab wala hai.
ayahs.8: (fay ka maal) un muhajir miskeenon ke liye hai jo apne gharon se aur apne maalon se nikaal diye gaye hain. Woh Allah ke fazl aur us ki razamandi ke talabgaar hain aur Allah Taala ki aur us ke Rasool ki madad karte hain. Yehi raastbaaz log hain.
ayahs.9: Aur (un ke liye) jinhon ne is ghar mein (yaani Madina) aur imaan mein un se pehle jagah bana li hai aur apni taraf hijrat karke aane walon se mohabbat karte hain aur muhajireen ko jo kuchh de diya jaaye is se woh apne dilon mein koi tangi nahin rakhte balke khud apne upar unhein tarjeeh dete hain go khud ko kitni hi sakht haajat ho. (Baat yeh hai) ke jo bhi apne nafs ke bukhl se bachaya gaya wohi kaamyaab (aur ba-muraad) hai.
ayahs.10: Aur (un ke liye) jo un ke baad aayen jo kahenge ke ae hamare Parwardigaar hamein bakhsh de aur hamare un bhaiyon ko bhi jo hum se pehle imaan la chuke hain aur imaandaaron ki taraf se hamare dil mein keena (aur dushmani) na daal, ae hamare Rabb beshak tu shafqat-o-meharbani karne wala hai.
ayahs.11: Kya tu ne munafiqon ko na dekha? Ke apne Ahl-e-Kitab kaafir bhaiyon se kehte hain agar tum jila-watan kiye gaye to zaroor bil-zaroor hum bhi tumhare saath nikal khade honge aur tumhare baare mein hum kabhi bhi kisi ki baat na maanenge aur agar tum se jang ki jaayegi to bakhuda hum tumhari madad karenge, lekin Allah Taala gawahi deta hai ke yeh qatan jhoote hain.
ayahs.12: Agar woh jila-watan kiye gaye to yeh un ke saath na jaayenge aur agar un se jang ki gayi to yeh un ki madad (bhi) na karenge aur agar (bil-farz) madad par aa bhi gaye to peeth pher kar (bhaag khade) honge phir madad na kiye jaayenge.
ayahs.13: (Musalmano! Yaqeen maano) ke tumhari haibat un ke dilon mein ba-nisbat Allah ki haibat ke bahut zyada hai, yeh is liye ke yeh be-samajh log hain.
ayahs.14: Yeh sab mil kar bhi tum se lad nahin sakte haan yeh aur baat hai ke qila-band maqamaat mein hon ya deewaron ki aad mein hon, un ki ladaai to un mein aapas mein hi bahut sakht hai go aap unhein muttahid samajh rahe hain lekin un ke dil darasal ek doosre se juda hain. Is liye ke yeh be-aql log hain.
ayahs.15: Un logon ki tarah jo un se kuchh hi pehle guzre hain jinhon ne apne kaam ka wabaal chakh liya aur jin ke liye alamnak azaab (tayyar) hai.
ayahs.16: Shaitaan ki tarah ke us ne insaan se kaha kufr kar, jab woh kufr kar chuka to kehne laga main to tujh se bari hoon, main to Allah Rabb-ul-Aalameen se darta hoon.
ayahs.17: Pas dono ka anjaam yeh hua ke aatish (dozakh) mein hamesha ke liye gaye aur zaalimon ki yehi saza hai.
ayahs.18: Ae imaan walo! Allah se darte raho aur har shakhs dekh (bhaal) le ke kal (qayamat) ke waaste us ne (aamaal ka) kya (zakheera) bheja hai. Aur (har waqt) Allah se darte raho. Allah tumhare sab aamaal se bakhabar hai.
ayahs.19: Aur tum un logon ki tarah mat ho jaana jinhon ne Allah (ke ahkaam) ko bhula diya to Allah ne bhi unhein apni jaanon se ghaafil kar diya, aur aise hi log nafarmaan (faasiq) hote hain.
ayahs.20: Ahl-e-Naar aur Ahl-e-Jannat (baaham) barabar nahin. Jo Ahl-e-Jannat hain wohi kaamyaab hain (aur jo Ahl-e-Naar hain woh nakaam hain).
ayahs.21: Agar hum is Quran ko kisi pahaad par utaarte to tu dekhta ke khauf-e-Ilahi se woh past ho kar tukde tukde ho jaata. Hum in misaalon ko logon ke saamne bayan karte hain taake woh ghaur-o-fikr karein.
ayahs.22: Wohi Allah hai jis ke siwa koi mabood nahin, chhupe khule ka jaanne wala, Mehrban aur Rahm karne wala.
ayahs.23: Wohi Allah hai jis ke siwa koi mabood nahin, Badshah, Nihayat Paak, Sab Aibon Se Saaf, Aman Dene Wala, Nigehbaan, Ghalib Zor-Aawar, aur Badaai Wala. Paak hai Allah un cheezon se jinhein yeh us ka shareek banaate hain.
ayahs.24: Wohi Allah hai Paida Karne Wala, Wajood Bakhshne Wala, Soorat Banaane Wala, isi ke liye (nihayat) achchhe naam hain. Har cheez khwah woh aasmanon mein ho khwah zameen mein ho us ki paaki bayan karti hai, aur wohi Ghalib Hikmat wala hai.
